title: Recensement de la Nouvelle-Orléans (1721) — original manuscript scan

publisher: University of North Carolina Press / Omohundro Institute

author: Marc de Villiers du Terrage; translator of historic excerpt unspecified

title: 9–10 February 1730 letter from Diron d'Artaguiette on Périer and Régis du Roullet's Choctaw mission
author: Historic New Orleans Collection, A Guide to French Louisiana Manuscripts

title: Journal of Diron d'Artaguiette (1722–1723), published in Travels in the American Colonies

publisher: Macmillan; digitized by Library of Congress

title: French sources for the Choctaw villages and the 1730 trade post
author: Stephen R. Cook
publisher: The Choctaw Villages historical research site
locator: Narrative based on translated original instructions for 1730 Régis du Roullet mission; notes about 800 livres' presents and nine instructions. This interpretive website has not been source-audited against the actual signed 1729 instructions; figures not added as transaction proof.

title: Louisiana Retrocession — original French document dated January 24, 1731
author: Louisiana Historical Center, Louisiana Colonial Documents Digitization Project
locator: Document 1731-01-24-03, New Orleans, French Superior Council, 24 page public image series; tagged 'Retrocession of Louisiana', people index Coligny, Company of Indies, Le Redde, Orry. Full handwriting not transcribed, and this is NOT the date of legal completion.

title: Arrêt du Conseil d'État concernant la rétrocession de la concession de la Louisiane et du pays des Illinois
author: French Council of State, catalogued by Bibliothèque nationale de France
locator: BnF item 'Arrêt du conseil d'Etat concernant la rétrocession faite à S. M. par la Compagnie des Indes de la concession de la Louisiane et du pays des Illinois', 1731. Specific decree articles/full scan NOT read; catalogue confirms legal act exists.

title: Company Louisiana debts decree dated 24 February 1731, printed in 1733
author: French Council of State, catalogued by Bibliothèque nationale de France
locator: Gallica ark:/12148/btv1b8602624n, linked under 'Compagnie des Indes' in BnF France-Amériques, 1733 printed edition. Columbia Law catalogue 1505745 dates the underlying decree to 24 February 1731. Gallica image fetch returned 403 in this research environment: clauses NOT read, no liability allocation or payment proven.

title: Louisiana History: Colonial Louisiana
author: Louisiana State Museums
locator: Narrative of Company of West/Indies administering Louisiana and returning colony to French Crown after setbacks, with French royal government continuing to 1763. Condensed summary, not legal text.

title: Edme Gatien Salmon to minister, taking possession of Company forts for the king, 19 January 1732
author: Historic New Orleans Collection, Guide to French Louisiana Manuscripts
locator: HNOC Surrey Calendar item 7287: Jan 19 1732, Salmon (commissaire-ordonnateur) to minister, ANOM C13 15:31, two pages; claims possession of forts, buildings and artillery except Illinois, Natchitoches, and 'Youanis (Yazoo)' and dispute with MacMahon over company merchandise. Description not original letter text. 'Youanis (Yazoo)' must not automatically be equated with Choctaw Haiyowvni trading post.

title: Minister of Marine to Edme Gatien Salmon, 2 September 1732 (Diron–Company dispute)
author: Historic New Orleans Collection, Guide to French Louisiana Manuscripts
locator: HNOC Surrey item 7620, Sep 2 1732, ANOM B57:815; two-page ministerial letter from Marly to Salmon, among topics approves Superior Council decision in case of Diron and Company of the Indies. Original text and sum not reproduced in abstract.

title: North American Indigenous Societies Research Pathfinder: Manuscripts and Microfilms
author: Historic New Orleans Collection
locator: MSS 596 Caillot 1729–1731 Company clerk's illustrated account; MSS 717 1720–21 travel journal; MF17 Archives Nationales microfilms. Curatorial synopsis includes Indigenous diplomacy and colonial encounters. Original manuscript images/text have not been fully read.

title: Arrest du Conseil d'Estat du roy concernant le payement des dettes de la Compagnie des Indes à la Louisiane
author: French Council of State
publisher: Columbia Law Library catalogue; printed Paris 1733
locator: Columbia record 1505745: original edict title explicitly 'Du 24 février 1731', 2 pages, PRINTED at Paris in 1733. Date of royal decree 1731-02-24; 1733 is printed edition date. Full legal articles and payments not read.

title: Homicide, impérialisme et vengeance en Louisiane française entre 1738–1740
author: Conflictualité research journal (University of Limoges)
locator: Footnotes 38–39: original 1731-01-23 retrocession decision indexed ANOM COL F3 242 fol.187; follow-up 1731-05-22 Council legal-composition decree at F3 242 fol.190 excluding Company directors from Superior Council. Research article interpreted; original folios not read.

title: 1731 Arrest du Conseil d'Estat du Roy — Louisiana retrocession original printed decree
author: French Royal Council; University of Missouri–St. Louis Mercantile Library archival exhibition
publisher: University of Missouri–St. Louis Mercantile Library
locator: Visible original printed title page: 'du 23. Janvier 1731' and concession 'Louisianne & du pays des Illinois'. Title/front page inspected; full decree clauses not inspected. Surrounding exhibition webpage has a demonstrably erroneous generic caption about transfer to Spain; rely on ORIGINAL TITLE PAGE, not that caption.

title: 1731 Imprimerie royale printing of the 24 February Louisiana Company-debt decree (BnF catalogue entry)
author: France. Conseil d'État (13..–1791), as indexed by Bibliothèque nationale de France
publisher: Paris: Imprimerie royale; BnF Catalogue général
locator: BnF filtered catalogue results, entry 39: '[Acte. 1731-02-24. Versailles] Arrest du Conseil... concernant le payement des dettes de la compagnie des Indes à la Louisiane... Impr. royale', publication year 1731. This is a catalogue-search result, not a stable item permalink or examination of operative text; confirm the individual BnF record and original copy.

title: A Catalogue of the Colonial Exhibit of the Louisiana Historical Society and Loan Exhibit of Members and Friends
author: Louisiana Historical Society
publisher: Louisiana Historical Society, New Orleans, 20 December 1903; public scan via Wikimedia Commons / Internet Archive
locator: Printed page 17 (PDF page 19, zero-indexed page 18), items 342 and 345: lists a 23 January 1731 retrocession decree and a 24 February 1731 Company-debt decree, both credited in the 1903 loan exhibit to Mr. Cusachs. Original catalogue page visually inspected 23 October 2026. Establishes reported exhibit possession in 1903, not present custody, legal clauses or actual payment.

title: Company of Indies: indexed French Superior Council and private documents, 1735–1737
author: Louisiana Historical Center / Louisiana Colonial Documents Digitization Project
locator: Company of Indies person/document index, rows 1735-10-19-02 (Private Documents, Agreement with Creditors); 1736-08-20-04 (Private Documents, Receipt); 1737-05-11-01 (Private Documents, Receipt). Linked item URLs /document/2450, /document/2689 and /document/3041 respectively. Categories and indexed participants inspected 24 Oct 2026; original French clauses and transactions NOT transcribed.

title: Louisiana Colonial Documents Digitization Project: indexing and translation process
author: Louisiana Historical Center / Louisiana State Museum
locator: Digitization and Indexing paragraphs; Translation/Transcription paragraphs: initial index derived from 1930s WPA abstracts; names of enslaved people and women significantly omitted, with spelling and numbering errors. WPA abstracts are not full transcriptions; checked 24 Oct 2026.

title: Louisiana Historical Center record 1732-07-15-01: indexed Duval succession statement of account
author: Louisiana Historical Center / Louisiana Colonial Documents Digitization Project
locator: French Superior Council document 1732-07-15-01, catalogued 15 July 1732, five manuscript pages, New Orleans; indexed participants Antoine Bruslé, Prévost, Company of Indies, François Duval succession. The modern record and image inventory were inspected 26 October 2026; original French account entries and the separately reported 15 January 1736 reference were NOT transcribed.
